response.note: Compares debit card success rate by issuer and acquirer across the two windows to localize the drop; the 'SUCCESS' status and 'DEBIT_CARD' payment_method literals are assumed values and may need adjusting to the actual data, and failure_category could be added as a follow-up breakdown.
response.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21' THEN 'Oct21-31' ELSE 'Oct10-20' END AS period, issuer_name, acquirer_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-10' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND payment_method = 'DEBIT_CARD' GROUP BY 1, issuer_name, acquirer_name ORDER BY issuer_name, acquirer_name, period LIMIT 50
